title: WorkflowManifest
description: Definition manifest for a Pocket-Agents workflow

workflowStep.description: A single step in a sequential workflow

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the workflow

ref.description: Reference to the agent id (for type=agent) or tool id (for type=tool) to invoke

inputMapping.description: Maps step input keys to dot-notation paths in workflow context (e.g. 'input.foo', 'steps.step1.bar') or literal values

outputKey.description: Optional label under which to store this step's output in workflow context (steps.<outputKey>); defaults to step id

timeoutMs.description: Optional maximum milliseconds this step may run before being aborted with a timeout error

onError.description: Error policy for this step. 'fail' (default) stops the workflow; 'continue' records failure and proceeds

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow does

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute sequentially
